# Benchmarks

This page compares the default transfer settings, other fixed settings and
`transfer-tuning: auto` on 3 providers and 3 cache sizes. See
[Performance](./performance.md) for what the settings do and how to select them.

## How the numbers were measured

- Run [39906947417](https://github.com/xSAVIKx/cloud-cache-action/actions/runs/39906947417) of the Transfer benchmark workflow, on 2026-10-23.
- Runner: `ubuntu-latest`, linux x64, 4 CPUs, 16 GiB RAM, node v24.21.0.
- Each configuration ran 2 times. The tables show the median transfer rate in MiB/s.
- The payload is random bytes, so the archive is about as large as the payload.
- The transfer rate is the S3 transfer alone. It does not include tar, compression or the sha256 check.
- **Bold** is the fastest fixed configuration in that column, and the `auto` row when it is
  as fast or faster.
- The `auto` rules come from an earlier sweep, run
  [39905131759](https://github.com/xSAVIKx/cloud-cache-action/actions/runs/39905131759). This
  page uses a different run, so the `auto` rows are not the data the rules were fitted to.
- The jobs for the three providers ran at the same time. The numbers depend on the region, the
  runner and the time of day. The same configuration can change by more than 30% between
  runs. Compare rows inside one table, not numbers between runs.

## `transfer-tuning: auto` against the defaults

A value above 1 means that `auto` was faster than the defaults.

| Restore | Amazon S3 | Cloudflare R2 | Google Cloud Storage |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 128 MiB | 1.13× | 3.22× | 1.60× |
| 512 MiB | 1.25× | 2.08× | 2.05× |
| 2 GiB | 1.46× | 2.89× | 2.62× |

| Save | Amazon S3 | Cloudflare R2 | Google Cloud Storage |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 128 MiB | 1.75× | 1.82× | 1.58× |
| 512 MiB | 1.34× | 1.20× | 1.11× |
| 2 GiB | 1.40× | 1.86× | 1.30× |

## 128 MiB cache

### Restore

| Download | Amazon S3 | Cloudflare R2 | Google Cloud Storage |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| defaults: 8 x 8 MiB | 121 | 47 | 67 |
| 8 x 16 MiB | 129 | 126 | 101 |
| 16 x 8 MiB | 134 | **133** | 80 |
| 16 x 16 MiB | 129 | 115 | **108** |
| 32 x 8 MiB | **141** | 125 | 85 |
| 32 x 16 MiB | 131 | 115 | 100 |
| 32 x 32 MiB | 120 | 75 | 95 |
| `transfer-tuning: auto` | 136 | **150** | **108** |

### Save

| Upload | Amazon S3 | Cloudflare R2 | Google Cloud Storage |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| defaults: 8 x 64 MiB | 57 | 27 | 60 |
| 8 x 16 MiB | **108** | 43 | 87 |
| 16 x 16 MiB | 101 | 44 | 88 |
| 16 x 32 MiB | 74 | 43 | 78 |
| 32 x 16 MiB | **108** | **53** | **94** |
| `transfer-tuning: auto` | 99 | 49 | **95** |

## Run the benchmark yourself

```sh
gh workflow run benchmark.yml -f size-mb=128,512,2048 -f matrix=sweep -f repeats=2
gh run download <run-id> --dir bench
node tests/ci/benchmarkPage.ts bench docs/guide/benchmarks.md [rules-run-id]
```
